servers.title: Servers
servers.noneBody: Add a Jellyfin + Jellyseerr pair to get started.
servers.deleteMessage: Remove "{{name}}" from this device. This does not affect the server itself.
servers.switchMessage: Sign out of the current server and connect to "{{name}}".

serverEdit.name: Name
serverEdit.hint: Include the scheme (http:// or https://) and no trailing slash. Both servers must be reachable from this device — LAN, VPN mesh, or public.
serverEdit.missingBody: Fill in a name and both URLs.

downloads.emptyBody: Offline playback is on the roadmap. Downloaded titles will appear here.

library.unavailableBody: Nothing answered. Check that the server is running, then try again.
library.unavailableAuth: Your session has expired. Sign out and back in to reconnect.
library.rowFailed: This row didn't load. Tap to try again.

requests.signedOut: Sign in to Jellyseerr to see your requests

confirmDeleteRequest.title: Delete request?
confirmDeleteRequest.message: The request will be cancelled but any downloaded files stay on Jellyfin.

confirmRemove.title: Remove from Jellyfin?
confirmRemove.message: This removes the media from Jellyseerr and asks Radarr/Sonarr to remove the file. Irreversible.

detail.castHint: Cast: {{state}} · AirPlay picker is inside the player

profile.title: Profile
profile.nameSaved: Name updated. Restart the app to see it everywhere.

subtitles.title: Subtitles
subtitles.note: Preferences are stored on this device. When the player finds a matching subtitle track for the media, it will be selected automatically.

playback.title: Playback
playback.autoplayNextDesc: Automatically play the next episode of a TV show when the current one ends.
playback.preferVLCDesc: Skip AVPlayer entirely. Slower start, works with every codec and container.
playback.note: The player still auto-selects VLC when a file's container or codec is not AVPlayer-compatible. Enabling 'Always use VLC' bypasses AVPlayer even for MP4/H.264 files.

content.title: Content
content.showAdultDesc: Include 18+ movies and TV in Search and Discover. Applies on this device only. Your Jellyseerr server must also allow adult content globally for it to appear.
content.adminIntro: The device toggle above only hides adult results on this phone. To control it for the whole server (and per user), open Jellyseerr:
content.nonAdminNote: Only the device toggle is available for non-admin accounts. Server-wide adult content control lives in Jellyseerr's admin.

language.title: Language
language.note: Restart the app for menu titles and system dialogs to fully update.
